procedures.heading: General information
steps: Trouble codes are displayed by the LED on the data link connector (DLC).
The ECM fault memory can also be checked and erased using diagnostic equipment connected to the data link connector (DLC).

procedures.heading: Accessing
steps: Ensure ignition switched OFF.
Open cover on black data link connector (DLC).
Insert selector cable in socket 2 [1] [1].
Switch ignition ON.
Depress test button for approximately 1 second [1] [2].
Count LED flashes [1] [3]. Note trouble code.
Each trouble code consists of three groups of flashes [2].
A 3 second pause separates each group [2] [A].
For example: Trouble code 223 displayed [2] -idle air control (lAC) valve.
Repeat switch operation [1] [2]. Note trouble codes. Compare with trouble code table.
Switch ignition OFF. Rectify faults as necessary.

procedures.heading: Erasing
steps: Ensure ignition switched OFF.
Insert selector cable in socket 2 [1] [1].
Access trouble codes.
Depress test button for approximately 5 seconds.
Release test button.
Wait for LED to illuminate.
Depress test button for approximately 5 seconds.
Release test button.
Depress test button for approximately 1 second.
Ensure trouble code 111 displayed.

Trouble code identification
No fault found — –
Engine control module (ECM) — ECM
Mass air flow (MAF) sensor — Wiring, MAF sensor
Engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor — Wiring, ECT sensor
Engine control module (ECM) – supply voltage low/high — Battery, alternator
Throttle position (TP) switch – CTP contacts — TP switch adjustment, accelerator cable adjustment, wiring, TP switch
Ignition control module (ICM) — ICM
Knock sensor (KS) 1 — Wiring, KS
Engine control module (ECM) – load signal — Wiring, ECM
Exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system – excessive flow detected — Wiring, EGR valve, EGR control module, engine coolant thermostat
Heated oxygen sensor (H02S) — Wiring, heating inoperative, MAF sensor, H02S
Throttle position (TP) switch – WOT contacts — TP switch adjustment, accelerator cable adjustment, wiring, TP switch
Engine speed (RPM) sensor – intermittent signal — Wiring, flywheel/drive plate damaged, air gap, RPM sensor
Fuel trim (FT), part load – too weak — Intake/exhaust leak, fuel pressure, wiring, MAF sensor, H02S
Idle air control (lAC) valve — Wiring, lAC valve
Engine coolant temperature (ECT) sensor — Wiring, ECT sensor
Fuel trim (FT), idling – weak/rich — Intake/exhaust leak, fuel pressure, excessive fuel in engine oil, injector(s), EVAP canister purge valve, wiring, MAF sensor, ECT sensor, H02S
Throttle position (TP) switch – CTP contacts — TP switch adjustment, accelerator cable adjustment, wiring, TP switch
Exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) system – insufficient flow detected — Hose leak/blockage, wiring, EGR valve, EGR control module, EGRT sensor, engine coolant thermostat
Turbocharger (TC) wastegate regulating valve — Wiring, TC wastegate regulating valve
Vehicle speed sensor (VSS) — Wiring, speedometer, VSS
Ignition control module (ICM) – KS signal missing — Wiring, ICM
Camshaft position (CMP) sensor- no/incorrect signal — Wiring, CMP sensor
Mass air flow (MAF) sensor – no filament burn- off signal — Wiring, ECM
Camshaft position (CMP) sensor- intermittent signal — Wiring, CMP sensor
NC compressor clutch cut-off relay — Wiring, A/C compressor clutch cut-off relay
Exhaust gas temperature sensor — Wiring, EGRT sensor
Throttle position (TP) sensor — Wiring, TP sensor
Exhaust gas recirculation temperature (EGRT) sensor — Wiring, EGRT sensor
Manifold absolute pressure (MAP) sensor — Hose leak/blockage, Turbocharger (TC), TC control module
Throttle position (TP) sensor — Wiring, TP sensor
Engine control module (ECM) – load signal — Wiring, ECM if trouble code also stored in ICM
Engine coolant blower motor temperature sensor — Wiring, engine coolant blower motor temperature sensor
Engine control module (ECM) – overheating — Engine coolant blower motor, air supply blocked, module cooling fan
Knock sensor (KS) 2 — Wiring, KS
Fuel trim (FT) – too rich — Intake blockage, excessive fuel in engine oil, fuel pressure high, wiring, MAF sensor, H02S
Engine control module (ECM) – overheating — Engine coolant blower motor, air supply blocked, module cooling fan
